title: Other UK sellers
markdown:
# UK hair-loss market sweep (work in progress)

Interim listing generated from `uk-sweep.json`. The final, ranked write-up replaces this file when the sweep is complete.

| Name | Audience | Compounded | Deep dive? | Size signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Dr Fox](https://www.doctorfox.co.uk/hair-loss-treatments/) | men only (states it cannot supply hair-loss treatment to anyone not assigned male at birth) | True | yes | Trusted Shops 4.94/5 from 56,280 reviews (shown on page, Nov 2026); operating since 2010 (own claim). |
| [Pharmica](https://www.pharmica.co.uk/hair-loss/) | men (finasteride, Regaine for Men) and women (Regaine for Women) | False | no | Site claims 2.25 million+ customers and 255,783+ customer reviews; finasteride product shows 6,376 reviews. |
| [The Independent Pharmacy](https://www.theindependentpharmacy.co.uk/hair-loss) | men mainly; Regaine for Women listed | False | no | Finasteride product shows 142 reviews; site says 1,350+ medicines for 94 conditions. No patient count given. |
| [Well Pharmacy (Well Online Clinic)](https://well.co.uk/shop/online-clinic/hair-loss/) | men | False | no | Part of the Well pharmacy chain (chain size not stated on the page). |
| [Chemist4U](https://www.chemist-4-u.com/hair-loss) | men for prescription items; Regaine and Nourkrin for women | False | no | Large UK online pharmacy; no customer count on the hair-loss page. |
| [MedExpress](https://www.medexpress.co.uk/clinics/hair-loss) | men | False | no | Page states 'Trusted by over 2.6 million people' and Trustpilot 4.3/5. |
| [Click2Pharmacy](https://www.click2pharmacy.co.uk/online-clinic/hair-loss/) | men for prescription items; Regaine and Nourkrin for women | False | no | 'Rated Excellent on Trustpilot (8,300+ reviews)' shown in header. |
| [Chemist Click](https://www.chemistclick.co.uk/hair-loss-treatment) | men | False | no | Site shows 10,594 reviews and claims 300,000+ patients in the header (200,000+ on the hair-loss page). |
